_comment: Golden values for nos-footer-colour-logos (COUNCIL-1 C2 + TYPE-11, NOS Design ruling 2026-10-28, root comms.md ~line 4940). Every number is measured from the supplied files or taken from the ruling.

transparentPadding.note: identical to the reversed-gold file it replaces (alpha > 8), so the .nf-lockup negative margins stay as they are

credit.boxNote: 206 is the width of the OfficialMonoLockup the file replaces (SaocLockup.tsx w-[206px]). The art is trimmed to its ink (alpha bbox 0/0/0/0), so the img box is the ink box. Height follows the aspect: 165.
credit.alt: South African Orchid Council Making a difference since 1968
credit.altNote: The current accessible name of the credit link: OfficialMonoLockup has no aria-label, so the name is its visible text, wordmark then tagline. The dev records the live name on main before editing and the gate compares.
